title: FIELD: opening visual is detached at cover->inner host migration before incoming presentation is proven
sourceMechanism: GEN6 patch keeps earlyOpeningVisualLatched through INNER_HANDOFF but PanelEngine cover ownership is still conditional on current cover geometry.
At topology switch, setContinuityCoverOwned(false) synchronously ends the explicit opening visual even though the semantic opening attempt remains active.

The incoming inner PanelEngine later creates its own generic snapshot transition; it is not the same exact opening presentation attempt and has no service-stable presentation proof before outgoing teardown.
Existing Fold7PresentationLease evidence is currently host-local to DisplayMirrorHost/closing paths and is not gating this opening host migration.
recommendedBoundary: Treat cover->inner display remap as host migration inside one immutable opening attempt. Stage an incoming inner PUBLIC_GLASS/PRIVATE_FROST continuation immediately when the inner route appears, then retire the outgoing opening host only after exact-current incoming presentation evidence or explicit degraded timeout/reversal/privilege-loss. Wallpaper lifecycle must remain observational and must never satisfy readiness.
nonOverlap: Does not change coarse-90 authority, terminal native-cover fencing, 120Hz policy, or telemetry ownership; consumes their IDs/contracts.
